`77-77`: **🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🔵 Trivial** | **⚡ Quick win** **The proposed repair needs a complete arity shape for `with-redefs`.** The plan names a "two/three-arity delayed test function". The production `exec-at` has arity 2 and arity 3. The `local_git_provider` caller uses `cljs$core$IFn$_invoke$arity$2`. Make sure the replacement defines the arity-2 property, for example through `(fn ([path args] ...) ([path args opts] ...))`. The test body must keep its in-flight counter and 5 ms delay. A plain `defn` helper outside `with-redefs` is also acceptable. Add this property check to the acceptance criteria, so the repair does not fail again with the same `TypeError`.
